info.name: TaskFlow API — Frontend Collection
info.description:
# 🖥️ Algonive Task Manager — Frontend API Collection

This collection mirrors the frontend service layer ([`Frontend/src/services/api.js`](../../src/services/api.js)) **request-for-request**, so every call the React app makes can be tested directly in Postman.

## 🗺️ How the collection is organized
Each folder maps 1-to-1 to an exported service object used by the pages:

| Folder | Service object | Used by pages |
|---|---|---|
| 🏥 System & Health | — | app monitoring |
| 🔐 Auth API | `authAPI` | Login, Signup, Profile, Forgot/Verify/Reset password |
| 👥 Team API | `teamAPI` | TeamPage, Settings |
| 📋 Task API | `taskAPI` | Dashboard, TaskBoard, TaskForm, TaskWorkspace |
| 🔔 Notification API | `notificationAPI` | Notifications, Navbar |
| 💬 Messaging API | `messagingAPI` | Messaging (E2E encrypted chat) |

## 🔗 Frontend routing context
React Router pages that trigger these APIs:
`/login`, `/signup`, `/forgot-password`, `/verify-otp`, `/reset-password` (public) · `/dashboard`, `/board`, `/tasks/new`, `/tasks/:id`, `/tasks/:id/workspace`, `/teams`, `/notifications`, `/messaging`, `/settings`, `/profile` (protected).

## ⚡ Quick Start
1. Import this file into Postman (**Import → File**).
2. Collection variables: set `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:5000` — same as `VITE_API_URL`), `email`, `password`.
3. Run **🔐 Auth API → Login** — the JWT is saved to `{{token}}` exactly like the axios interceptor puts it in `localStorage.token`.
4. Every protected request sends `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` automatically.
5. IDs are auto-captured as you run requests, mirroring how pages chain calls.

item.name: 🔐 Auth API
item.description:
Mirrors `authAPI` from `api.js`. Powers the public routes `/signup`, `/login`, `/forgot-password`, `/verify-otp`, `/reset-password` and the protected `/profile` page.

**Flow:** Signup → token saved → Login (re-run anytime to refresh `{{token}}`) → Profile → Logout. Password reset: Forgot Password → read OTP from email → set `{{otp}}` → Verify OTP (captures `{{resetToken}}`) → Reset Password.

request.description:
`authAPI.signup(data)` — `POST /auth/signup` · Called from the **Signup page**.

Body: `name` (2–50), `email`, `password` (min 6), optional `role` (`member` default) + `adminInviteToken` for admins.
Returns: `token`, `user { id, name, email, role }`. Auto-captures `token` + `userId`.

`authAPI.login(data)` — `POST /auth/login` · Called from the **Login page** and by `AuthContext` on app load.

Account locks 15 min after 5 failed attempts. Returns a 7-day JWT.
Auto-captures `token` + `userId` (equivalent to `localStorage.setItem('token', ...)`).

exec: console.log('✅ token saved — protected requests now authorized');

request.description:
`authAPI.getMe()` — `GET /auth/me` · Called by `AuthContext` to restore the session and by the **Profile page**.

Returns the user without `passwordHash`, with populated `teams`.

Profile settings — `PUT /auth/profile` · Called from the **Profile page** save action.

Body: `name` and/or `email` (both optional). Rejects an email already used by another account.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200 (or 400 if email taken)', () => [200, 400].includes(pm.response.code));

request.description:
Password reset step 1 — `POST /auth/forgot-password` · **ForgotPassword page**.

Sends a 6-digit OTP email (valid 10 min). Always returns 200 (never reveals account existence). One request per 5 min. Copy the OTP into `{{otp}}`.

exec: console.log('📧 Set the otp variable from the email, then run Verify OTP');

request.description:
Password reset step 2 — `POST /auth/verify-otp` · **VerifyOTP page**.

Validates the 6-digit OTP (3 attempts max) and returns a 15-minute `resetToken`. Auto-captures `resetToken`.

Password reset step 3 — `POST /auth/reset-password` · **ResetPassword page**.

Requires `newPassword` === `confirmPassword` (min 6 chars). After success, update the `password` variable and login again.

exec: console.log('✅ password variable updated — login again');

request.description: Logout action — `POST /auth/logout` · Navbar/Profile logout. The frontend clears `localStorage` (token/user) and redirects to `/login`.

item.name: 👥 Team API
item.description: Mirrors `teamAPI` from `api.js`. Powers the **Teams page** (`/teams`) and team pickers across the app. Only the creator (or admin) can update teams or manage members.

request.description:
`teamAPI.create(data)` — `POST /teams` · Create-team modal on the **Teams page**.

Creator automatically becomes the first member. Auto-captures `teamId`.

`teamAPI.getAll()` — `GET /teams` · Loads the **Teams page**, Dashboard team filter and TaskForm team dropdown.

Auto-captures `teamId` from the first team if not set.
`teamAPI.getById(id)` — `GET /teams/:id` · Team detail view with members and creator populated. Non-members get 403.
`teamAPI.update(id, data)` — `PUT /teams/:id` · Edit-team form. Only the team creator is allowed.

`teamAPI.addMember(id, data)` — `POST /teams/:id/add-member` · Add-member form on the **Teams page**.

Adds a registered user by email and creates a `team_invite` notification for them. Signup a second user first and set `{{memberEmail}}`.

`teamAPI.removeMember(teamId, userId)` — `DELETE /teams/:id/remove-member/:userId` · Member row remove button.

Only the team creator or an admin. ⚠️ Set `{{memberId}}` to the member's id (captured by Add Member, else edit manually).

item.name: 📋 Task API
item.description:
Mirrors `taskAPI` from `api.js`. Powers the **Dashboard** (`/dashboard`), **TaskBoard** (`/board`), **TaskForm** (`/tasks/new`, `/tasks/:id`) and **TaskWorkspace** (`/tasks/:id/workspace`).

Suggested order: Create Task → list/detail → update/status → attachments → stats/feed → Delete Task last.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Implement login page",
  "description": "Build the login UI with validation and error states",
  "team": "{{teamId}}",
  "assignee": "{{userId}}",
  "status": "pending",
  "priority": "high",
  "dueDate": "2026-10-15T00:00:00.000Z",
  "tags": ["frontend", "auth"],
  "checklist": [
    { "text": "Design the form layout", "completed": true },
    { "text": "Wire up the API call", "completed": false }
  ]
}

request.description:
`taskAPI.create(data)` — `POST /tasks` · Submit on the **TaskForm** page (`/tasks/new`).

Requires a `team` the user belongs to. Assigning someone else triggers an in-app notification + assignment email. Status: `pending | in_progress | completed` · Priority: `low | medium | high`.
Auto-captures `taskId`.
`taskAPI.getAll(params)` — `GET /tasks` · Loads the **TaskBoard** (`/board`) with its filters, search and pagination.
`taskAPI.getById(id)` — `GET /tasks/:id` · Loads the **TaskForm** edit mode (`/tasks/:id`) and **TaskWorkspace**. Cached 15 min server-side; the axios layer caches it 60 s too.
`taskAPI.update(id, data)` — `PUT /tasks/:id` · Save on the **TaskForm** edit page. Status/assignee changes stream into the team activity feed.
`taskAPI.updateStatus(id, data)` — `PATCH /tasks/:id/status` · Drag-and-drop / status buttons on the **TaskBoard**. Completing notifies creator/assignee in-app + email.

`taskAPI.uploadAttachments(taskId, formData)` — `POST /tasks/:id/attachments` · File upload in the **TaskWorkspace**. `multipart/form-data` with field `files`.

Auto-captures `attachmentId`.

`taskAPI.getAttachments(taskId)` — `GET /tasks/:id/attachments` · Attachment list in the **TaskWorkspace**.

Auto-captures `attachmentId` if not set.

`taskAPI.downloadAttachment(attachmentId)` — `GET /tasks/attachments/:attachmentId/download` · Fetched as `responseType: 'blob'` by the frontend.

In Postman use **Send and Download**. 410 if the file is gone from storage.
`taskAPI.getStats()` — `GET /tasks/stats/dashboard` · KPI cards and charts on the **Dashboard** (`byStatus`, `myTasks`, `overdueTasks`, `statusHistory`).
`taskAPI.getActivityFeed(params)` — `GET /tasks/activity/feed` · Recent-activity widget on the **Dashboard**.

`taskAPI.delete(id)` — `DELETE /tasks/:id` · Delete button (creator/admin only). Also removes attachments from disk + activity records.

⚠️ Run last in this folder.

item.name: 🔔 Notification API
item.description: Mirrors `notificationAPI` from `api.js`. Powers the **Notifications page** (`/notifications`) and the unread badge in the **Navbar**. Real-time push arrives via Socket.IO `user:{id}` room.

request.description:
`notificationAPI.getAll(params)` — `GET /notifications` · Notification list + navbar unread badge (`unreadCount`).

Auto-captures `notificationId`.
`notificationAPI.markAsRead(id)` — `PUT /notifications/:id/read` · Click on a single notification.
`notificationAPI.markAllAsRead()` — `PUT /notifications/read-all` · "Mark all read" button in the Navbar dropdown.

`notificationAPI.delete(id)` — `DELETE /notifications/:id` · Delete icon on a notification row.

⚠️ Run last.

item.name: 💬 Messaging API
item.description:
Mirrors `messagingAPI` from `api.js`. Powers the **Messaging page** (`/messaging`) with end-to-end encrypted chat (X25519 key exchange + AES-GCM payloads) and Socket.IO realtime.

**Flow:** Register Key → Create Conversation → Get Participants (fetch public keys) → Send Message → Get/Search Messages → Export.

request.description: `messagingAPI.registerKey(data)` — `POST /messaging/keys` · Called by `MessagingContext` on connect to publish the user's public key.
`messagingAPI.lookupKeys(data)` — `POST /messaging/keys/lookup` · Fetch participants' public keys before encrypting a message.

`messagingAPI.createDirectConversation(data)` — `POST /messaging/conversations/direct` · "New direct message" picker on the **Messaging page**.

DMs allowed only within shared teams (admins exempt). Idempotent — returns the existing conversation. Auto-captures `conversationId`.

exec: pm.test('Status 201 (or 500 if DM not allowed)', () => pm.response.code < 500);

request.description: `messagingAPI.createTeamConversation(data)` — `POST /messaging/conversations/team` · Team chat channel on the **Messaging page**. Auto-captures `conversationId`.
`messagingAPI.listConversations()` — `GET /messaging/conversations` · Sidebar conversation list on the **Messaging page**.
`messagingAPI.updateRetention(conversationId, data)` — `PATCH /messaging/conversations/:id/retention` · Retention setting (`7d | 30d`), creator/admin only.
`messagingAPI.getParticipants(conversationId)` — `GET /messaging/conversations/:id/participants` · Member header + **public keys** for encrypting messages.
`messagingAPI.getMessages(conversationId, params)` — `GET /messaging/messages/:conversationId` · Loads chat history (newest first, cursor pagination).

`messagingAPI.sendMessage(data)` — `POST /messaging/messages` · Send button on the **Messaging page**.

Body is the E2E encrypted payload (`ciphertext` + `iv` + `authTag` + `recipients`). Emits Socket.IO `messaging:new` to the conversation room and each recipient's user room.
`messagingAPI.searchMessages(params)` — `GET /messaging/search` · In-chat search by sender/date range.

`messagingAPI.exportConversation(conversationId)` — `GET /messaging/export/:conversationId` · Export button; frontend downloads the JSON as a blob.

In Postman use **Send and Download**.
